review_description: I used this site to solicit some quotes for battery to add to my solar just because the Albanese government is offering socialist programs at the moment and I wanted to claw back some of my tax money .. so I'm not here to tell you renewable power is great or anything. I'm spending a lot of cash just to have an expensive backup option.i asked for a couple of quotes from rated installers on this site, I asked for their preferred systems including Victron and SMA which I have a lot of experience installing overseas. All companies replied with basically the same stuff.ECG came back with Powerwall 3 cheaper than anyone else, actually the price was substantially less than everyone else which was the deciding factor.The other factor was that the ECG guy actually came to the house to see the install conditions, I could tell they were not BS aussie sparks and had done this stuff a million times. So, the Powerwall is installed now, working fine. The guys who showed up had done it before in ACT so it was quick and smooth.
Great install of my Tesla powerwall 3 and ev chargerNot the easiest house the the installer to work with but the installer made it work

Arranging the quote was easy and was provided in a timely and professional manner. Followup information regarding the offering of the Sigenstor battery as a replacement for the 2 year old Tesla 2 (as it was not upgrade-able to the new Tesla3) was very logical and straightforward.The installation commenced at the time it was scheduled and took just one day.We were very impressed with the professional work of the tradies involved and the manner in which the job was performed.Communication was polite and informative and the worksite was fully cleaned up at end of day.We would not hesitate to recommend both ECG Electrical and our SIGENERGY Battery system.

ECG sales/quoting process was transparent and honest - no high pressure stuffECG Electrical installed our panels & battery at a very competitive price. The team did a great job - finished everything in a day, as plannedCustomers service was great - organised grid connection, showed how to use app. followed up to make sure all running smoothly, answered questionsThanks. Very happy customers :)
Punctual and tidy installation in one day we are very happy with the installation

The team at ECG Solar is very efficient and professional. They made the whole process smooth and stress-free, keeping us informed at every step. Easy to work with and very reliable. detail. I would definitely recommend ECG Solar to anyone looking for quality solar installation and excellent customer service!

Fantastic experience with ECG. Highly professional and great installation. Great work and good communication throughout the whole process. We had quotes from five companies and ECG were the only one who insisted on attending in person and created a meaningful connection.I definitely recommend ECG for a solar installation in Canberra

I was very impressed by the efficiency and the service exhibited by ECG Electrical for our recent battery installation.  They were punctual, neat and efficient and went that extra distance to help me reorganise the garage to put the battery in a better place than I had originally intended.  Everything was explained to me and I was monitoring battery performance as soon as the work was done.  I would strongly recommend them.

ECG installed a 15kwh PV array with a battery ready inverter. Dealing with ECG has been a pleasure from start to finish. With the install done in the one day.  I am also happy to have the system installed by a local provider that install and warrant the work they undertake. Happy to recommend .

I had a full solar and batteries system installed by ECG Electrical Pty Ltd and I can’t fault them. Everything from the quoting, the communication with the admin person in their office and the installation was excellent. The installation team arrived on time, were friendly and helpful, worked really hard and installed the whole system in one day and cleaned up thoroughly before they left. The team leader, Huxley, was lovely, very knowledgeable and professional (as were his whole team) Huxley took the time at the end of the day to explain how to use the system and the app. I’d very much recommend ECG Electrical Pty Ltd for installation of solar panels and solar batteries
Very happy with ECG’s work. From quoting to installation they were professional and easy to deal with. They know their product and are reasonably priced. Very happy

Good value quote. Quick and simple to get quotes and adjustments (I had several) made. Was a little sketchy not having a virtual or in person site inspection prior to installation but they coped with problems that came up as a result pretty well. Great communication during install and really quick and efficient. Seems like a great team.Pre-install communication could be better - no confirmation email/text/call after preliminary scheduling.

The sales team were professional and respectful. The quote was the best value for a bigger and better system than the two alternatives we explored.What was really incredible is the extra effort they went to when I asked to sign on the last working day before the financial year end, when the ACT Govt free loan offer expired. They worked all weekend to process my application and get it to the credit provider in time.The installation was booked in for a day four months in advance and happened in one day on the very day. Any business which can manage a schedule so reliably must know their stuff.The three young men who installed were very courteous and friendly. More importantly, they were experts, communicated what they would do, when and how and did it neatly and with no fuss.The entire process, from initial consultation, through recommendations of the best system for us through the paperwork, grid connection, app setup and after installation follow up was seamless.If only there were more businesses in Canberra with such a high standard of customer service.

I had a fantastic experience with ECG for my solar installation from start to finish. The quote was detailed, transparent, and returned promptly, which gave me confidence right away. They even conducted a site visit before I accepted the quote, taking the time to answer all my questions thoroughly.Installation was impressively fast—although I was told it could take up to 14 weeks, the system was installed just 3 weeks after I accepted the quote. The team was professional, efficient, and easy to deal with throughout the process.The customer service was outstanding. Every interaction was friendly, informative, and supportive. They were always available to answer questions, kept me updated throughout the process, and made sure I felt confident in every step. It’s clear they genuinely care about their customers and take pride in delivering a great experience.Highly recommend ECG for anyone considering solar. Great service, great communication, and a great result!

The quoting process was good and provided me with all the information I needed to make a decision about my battery installation. The actual installation was done in a timely and efficient manner. The installation team arrived at 7.30am as they had said they would. They were professional but friendly and I found them very easy to deal with. They were also very tidy and removed all the waste material when they left. The grid connection was organised by the installers and they gave me a run down on how to use the battery at the end of their work. ECG also installed the solar panels on my house roof in 2024 and that job was done to my complete satisfaction as well.
Everything was smooth with good communication throughout the process. Very happy with my new battery and am enjoying the move to Amber Electric

The team from ECG offered the best quote for a 3x8 kW battery out of three local companies. They were prompt in conducting a site visit and were fully knowledgeable about the standards for battery location.We agreed on an installation date and they stuck to it, turning up on time and completing the installation that day, despite our house having a few access issues for such heavy equipment. The site was left clean and tidy.The installers gave me a good run down of the battery operation and they took care of all grid connections and regulatory requirements.The manual and warranties were provided and the activation of the battery App worked without a hitch.We had a very good experience and would happily recommend ECG.

With the ACT sustainable scheme for batteries ending without much notice, ECG quickly got my quote out and accepted. The work was scheduled and delivered on time. They worked with my existing setup instead of other providers who wanted to do new setup. This saved having to remove my existing inverter which would have potentially gone to landfill. The system is working  perfectly. I am glad I went with local expertise. Thabk you to the team for all the hard work.

With the solar cells there was a bit of negotiation on the correct placement on our roof. ECG hit on an elegant solution by dividing the placement to two locations which got the best sun and were out of the way for roof maintenance and visual from the street.  ECG explained the benefits of the Synergy battery - modular, accepts direct DC current from the cells, can power the house if there is a black out.For both installations we found ECG staff, punctual, polite and most importantly cleaned up after themselves.  They help us put the app on our phones, set it up so it worked seamless ever since and trained my wife and I on how to use them.  It was a delight to work with ECG and I cannot recommend them enough. The attached photos show that the installation looks neat and tidy and has worked well ever since it was installed.

I chose ECG Electrical for my Solar Installation as my sister used them for her system and she was very happy.  My own experience was exactly the same. The whole process was seamless. From quoting to installation was all done whilst I was living overseas!  They are always quick to respond to all correspondence and are very knowledgeable and helpful.  I highly recommend this business.

We recently had the team from ECG Electrical complete a major overhaul and upgrade of our solar energy system at our home on the Sunshine Coast. The project, undertaken by a team of amazing electrical and solar professionals, was completed in 3 days.This was no small feat, considering the scope of the project, which included removing the now inefficient 20 year old solar panels and solar hot water system from the tile roof, replacing them with 41 x 450W latest technology solar panels, removing the existing 5Kw inverter and replacing it with a 20.0kW Sigenergy 3 Phase Energy Controller with 4 MPPTs, installing six Sigenergy batteries with a total battery storage capacity of 48Kw, installing an iStore 18.4kW Pool Heat Pump and finally a SPT Phantom All-in-One 270 Litre Heat Pump to provide an endless supply of hot water to our large 4++ bedroom home.The team from ECG provided exceptional before, during and after installation service and delivered a complex project on time and on budget. We couldn't be happier with the outcome and highly recommend ECG Electrical for all your solar and electrical needs here on the Sunshine Coast.

Prior to proceeding with ECG they answered many questions I had regarding possible location of the panels, location of the inverter use of stands etc and they also visited my home several times.I obtained three quotes and ECG supplied the most competitive price which was markedly cheaper. The quote was very detailed and entailed the removal of my old 10kw 55 panel system and the installation of a new 10kw 21 panel system. The installation was very neat and no penetration of my roof was required which means I don’t have to worry about leaks. The complete old system was replaced including cabling. The team worked from 8am to 6pm during which we had several showers in the area.As a result of replacing my old 10kw system of 55 panels with 10kw system using 21 panels I now have considerable spare roof space to add another 20kw system.As I was replacing like for like system there was no need for grid connection after install. I now have a simple solar edge app which shows me in real time what my system is generating. I highly recommend ECG for their professional service throughout the process from start to finish.

ECG were happy to provide multiple comprehensive quotes for different options. They were transparent about how the various rebates applied. I independently researched the prices of various components, and ECG offered the best deal on price, from the field of three recommended installers.After the deposit was paid they organized the installation promptly. However, I did have to insist on getting a site inspection, as I wanted to be sure about the location of the battery before the installation date. ECG did provide this once I requested it.Installation went smoothly. They had a big crew, and seem to have done a very solid job. So far very happy with the system performance, it is delivering exactly as designed.

We engaged ECG to install a second PW2. They were professional, on time and super helpful.It was a complicated install, but they were able to sort everything out with minimal input required.We would absolutely engage them in the future.

Second time that I have had excellent service from ECG for the installation of batteries. Any contact with the firm from initial contact, consultation and followup service has been excellent. Any questions were handled without smoke screening. Totally professional and caring service at all levels. 10+
Very happy with customer service prior to installation and professionalism of installers

The process from start to finish was smooth and easy. Good advice was provided initially, followed up with a competitive quote. The install was conducted on time as promised, despite it being on one of Canberra's worst winter days. The follow-up by ECG was appreciated, and the system has been working great since.

ECG was recomended by solar quotes. They came to our home to see our custom needs (panels on the hose and garage- inverter in the garage to suit later battery and charging station instalation). They gave quotes for a few options, arrived on the agreed date, did a clean effective job and gave us all the info and were friendly and professional. This year they sent an offer for matching solar edge batteries and installed the batteries in the planned. location. The system has performed without any issues and within specs. I highly recommend ECG for professional service.

ECG completed our initial 20kw panel install along with a single Tesla Powerwall several years ago.  Fast forward to now, with the government rebates and a special on the runout of the Powerwall 2, we decided to install a second battery to boost our storage capacity.  Every interaction we have had with ECG has been a breeze and hassle free, and their after sales service is impeccable.  We have had both family and friends share the same experience, everyone cannot speak highly enough of their experience with ECG Electrical.  A great Canberra business and very worthy of their reputation.
ECG did a fantastic job: communicative, flexible and the installation was neat and tidy. No regrets for choosing them and have been recommending them to others.

Couldn't fault the ECG process: practical advice for the initial "site scoping" and simple quote process. The actual installation couldn't have been smoother, and we are very impressed with the result. Tidy installation with minimal visible cabling and/or conduits, completed the whole installation in a day (including second storey solar install).Our existing solar system was completely integrated with the new (Sigenergy) battery and additional solar panels.
Sunshine Coast Queensland installation. I was a bit concerned initially, as this seemed to be a relatively new expansion of ECG from their home-base in Canberra, but all has gone very well.

The company was prompt in dealing with us, and we had a very useful site visit which resulted in us ordering a larger but cheaper system. Wait time was not too long. I appreciated the fact that only 25% was required as a deposit. One hitch with installation but it was sorted out and all was done in one day. Very happy so far with the performance of the system and the app.

reviewer_name: Stuart On Behalf Of My Son James
review_description: Turned up on time, installation was smooth and we were informed of progress along the way.

We were impressed with the service ECG gave us from initial consultation to installation of our Solar System. The whole team were professional and efficient through each phase of the project. We would recommend ECG Electrical Canberra to anyone that needs to install Solar, or upgrade their gas hot water to heat pump or heating/cooling to reverse cycle.

I bought a 6.6kW system from ECG Electrical in ACT. They attended my property as part of the quotation and took time to answer my questions before and after the quote. They offered the best options, optimised for my circumstances, and offer the best value for money. On the day, the installation team were punctual, professional and did a super job. Overall, I'm really impressed and happy to recommend ECG Electrical.

After dealing with 4 different installers and receiving a variety of quotes from each, Ilanded on ECG as they gave me the most confidence that they’d do a good job. They physically attended the property (unlike their competitors) right from the get go, and while they weren’t the cheapest, they eventually came around to matching a competitors price.The install went smoothly and the crew were professional and friendly. System is up and running and working well, as it should.My only gripe was the installation of the canopy over the inverter. It was installed too low (twice). Have spoken to one of the company directors asd have been assured it will be rectified.Would use ECG again, and recommend them to others (as I already have).

ECG did the online proposal based on my usage and then came out and did a site inspection when I confirmed I was interested.Their options were cost effective and well explained. in the end their service, warranty and price made us chose them.ECG do their own installs and the team were prompt, cleaned up after themselves and did a neat job on the cabling and install.Their estimates were conservative and so far we are generating well over the estimate even with shading.I'd happily recommend them

After seeking three quotes, I was immediately impressed with the responsiveness of ECG and their ability to answer my questions quickly and easily. I was tossing up different combinations of system but ended up with panels, inverter, and heat pump. I ultimately chose ECG over the other quotes because I was attracted to them as a family business (their materials talked about their personalised service rather than their commercial clients), and the pre-install admin was personal and easy to negotiate. The guys doing the install were all highly professional and respectful of the impact of the work, and were super easy to deal with. The system is working great so far (day 5), and I'm extremely pleased with the whole process from start to finish.
The installers were professional, fast and knowledgeable about the products they were installing

Sales/quoting was very responsive and included site visit where process and equipment options were very well explained.The installation occurred on schedule - it was a long day for the installers, I was impressed they completed it within the day. There was minimal disruption to our electricity.We love the new system, it is delivering as promised. We love the monitoring app.
The team arrived on time, job was completed on time and left the house clean. They made a few aesthetic changes which were much appreciated.  Early on but the system works well.

ECG was the only one of the three companies quoting on my installation that insisted on coming out to visit the site. I wanted to max out the roof with panels, install batteries and an EV Charger. The job was complicated by the presence of an existing 13 year old PV system. Cailin (the sales rep) was excellent, answering my questions, discussing where best to locate components and helpfully identifying that the legacy rebate from my existing system was well worth preserving.Installation of panels, inverters, batteries and solar charger went very smoothly and was completed in a day. The old system was removed and the site left clean and tidy. The installation team was polite and efficient.It took a couple of days after installation to get all the bits talking to each other and the software performing correctly but Craig kept on the case until everything was right. The system has been inspected and an electrical certificate issued.

We have recently had a solar system installed by ECG Electrical and were very happy with the entire process. From first call, emails with office and onsite installers we found everyone to be very helpful and knowledgeable of the product. Thanks ECG

From the quote to the instal ECG Electrical were brilliant. Great customer service with nothing too hard to overcome. Very professional installation team and they even follow-up once complete to check whether everything is satisfactory and working to plan. Would highly recommend this company to anyone seeking a solar package.
ECG have been great. They turned up on time. They were super polite. The installation is neat and professional. It was a 10/10 experience. I will definitely be looking them up for the next job.

ECG electrical were great, from start to finish.Very upfront and honest about what would work, and why other options wouldn't be as good (significant shading). No question was too much, and they remained super respectful when they knew I was speaking to other companies - they didn't try sway me away from using anyone else, always just let me know what they could offer and why they weren't the cheapest, but overall I was very satisfied they were the best overall package and value.The sales to install process was smooth and no delays encountered, and they organised to work with a HVAC company to synchronise the shared services required for other upgrades required, and infact managed to do a huge amount of the solar install work a few days early whilst HVAC was happening meaning the actual install was super efficient on the day. They were flexible in installing inverter opposite side of house to meter to ensure it was in the best spot, accessible but out of sun and weather - it's those small details that show they are passionate about just getting it right.ECG organised literally everything in the background - meter upgrade request, network approvals and reports, STCs, everything. All I did was accept, pay a small deposit, final balance after install was complete and working. They did everything else.I cannot fault their service and professionalism from start to finish, and have no doubt if I have any further questions arise or issues were to develop, they will be right there willing to assist.

ECG Electrical were polite and professional from the start to finish. The day of installation, the workers were all very polite and communicated very well with me when issues came up, they were able to resolve the issue ensuring the process was smooth sailing. Once the solar panels were installed, i had a quick query and they called me within 30 minutes of my email in the late afternoon. They fitted my roof with a high quality panel and their pricing beat my other quotes with cheaper panels. Can't recommend them enough!
Great company and installation process. Felt so comfortable with them we left the house open while we did the grocery shop.

Great customer service. Craig came out to the house, listened to my concerns, discussed options and quoted panel and battery size suitable to my needs. Was not pushy at all and let me make decision in my own time to accept quote. Install was really quick, and the guys were lovely. Tidied up after themselves and explained the system and what would happen next. Would highly recommend ECG Electrical.

ECG installed our solar, heat pump and completed some electrical work around the house including an additional fuse box. Their initial engagement was great and the quality if the work was high.Unfortunately, on every engagement they did what they wanted rather than what was requested.I asked them to Max the solar capacity on my roof.. they didn't,I required the inverter on the other side of the house, they claimed it wasn't possible.. it was.I requested a new fuse box with specific sized circuits to run specialist equipment, they installed smaller circuits.I asked for our heat pump to be connected to the main switch box rather than the new closer fuse box.. they didn't, then shrugged and said they would need to leave my hot water off over Xmas and sort it out later.Every time they said, oh.. that wasn't quoted despite it clearly being requested or gave an excuse which has since been corrected by another electrician.After my last attempt to get the heat pump connected correctly the owner decided to communicate in a condescending way.The largest expense will be adding additional solar without the rebate being available and moving the inverter.I'll never use ECG again. I’m slowly getting their work corrected by other electricians to achieve what was initially requested.
Would comfortably recommend dealing with ECG. From initial quote to installation the process was seamless. Thank you

Got a quote from 4 companies and ended up going with ECG Electrical due to their solid reputation in Canberra as well as offering the most competitive price for the components they had put together. The installation went smoothly and they did an excellent job on the day with very neat cabling around the inverter. Only had the system for a month but it seems to be performing quite well.

ECG were super fast and efficient. The service was quite impersonal, it had a factory feel. But they covered everything I wanted to know before I even asked so it wasn't an issue. The install crew were really lovely and helpful. As far as I can tell ECG sorted everything perfectly.

I gave ECG 5/5 in all categories as I had nothing to complain about. I was indecisive about quality of the system as this would be marked against other systems and I know nothing about them. I’ve had two minor glitches, neither of which interfered with functionality. EGC also installed a Tesla Powerwall for my daughter and she was similarly pleased. Will recommend EGC to considering Solar.

A good company to deal with. Office staff were helpful and they organised a quote quickly. Installation was delayed for 2 months due to a backlog of work caused by wet weather. They came 2 days ago and finished the job in one day. The system is working well and the monitoring app is very useful. The fellows who installed the system were polite and to my eye the work looks neat and tidy.

Very happy with the informative advice and responsive service. Thrilled with the quality and price. Tidy. Punctual. Polite. Answered my multitude of silly questions with patience, and were very helpful.I will be using them again for additional work. (Replacement of hot water system from gas to electric.)Haven't bought a battery yet. Waiting to learn more about our usage pattern to decide whether it's worth it.

ECG did a pretty good job of discussing quotes and options throughout the whole process. They organised the grid connection and meter upgrade and that all seemed to go smoothly.I will definitely give a shoutout to their installation crews. They installed a couple of standard powerpoints in my garage (it previously only had one) and changed the line from the garage to a separate circuitbreaker (previously linked to another section of the house) at my request on the day. The day of install also had multiple small showers interrupting the installation. Towards the end of the day, they called in additional hands and managed to get the install done before sunset. Great Lads, much appreciated.

We received 3 quotes through Solarquotes and selected ECG Electrical on the basis that the person who came to talk to us was actually a manager in the business and not a salesperson regurgitating pre-prepared material.  We also liked the fact that they actually employed their own installers rather than using contractors.The quote wasn't the cheapest but we thought it was the best offering.The installation occurred as scheduled and we have no complaints about the workmanship.The site was actually left cleaner than when they arrived.We have had one minor problem with the inverter which they attended to in a timely manner.We were quoted a maximum daily production of 70 kW.  We have actually achieved 82+ on some days.

ECG were very prompt in quoting our system after initial contact with SolarQuotes. One of their techs organised a site visit and walked me through the options and best fit for our home.Come installation day the techs had great communication and cleaned up after themselves.The quality of the install looks great and I am very happy with the result.

We obtained quotes from three suppliers arranged by Solar Quotes. While all three were helpful, knowledgable, and prompt, we chose ECG as the best fit to our requirements despite not being the lowest cost. The service throughout has been professional, on time, and considerate. ECG sought fewer exclusions than the other two (such as tile replacement, arranging meter replacement, and dealing with cutover). In practice, the solution is working well, has been trouble-free, and the efficiency aspects of the system has resulted in significantly higher output, easily justifing the additional cost.Note: The cost (below) includes two systems (with separate inverters) including a separately-metered granny flat so the price is a bit misleading.

The process with both quotes was very satisfactory.  Responses were quick and all were helpful.  The installation happened much sooner than we anticipated, which was a good thing. the installers were friendly and quite knowledgeable in their respective fields. ECG were ere quick in organising all connections.

Nobody (that I know of) enjoys having to employ trades people to do work on their homes, but it is a necessary evil if you need a service. The concern of mess left behind or being late or not turning up at all and other issues is always on your mind.For my solar install (Canberra region) I went with ECG Electrical and I can say I was more than impressed with entire process from 1st initial contact through their website, right through to the install process.  Everything went smoothly,  no problems with a thing.  I was kept notified of the process of paperwork and install date and it all went smooth. From initial contact to install was no more than 4 weeks or so.The installation team were excellent, very respectful and helpful.  I have a slightly difficult shaped roof and nothing was a problem for the team and they installed a really neat system in the way I was hoping for.  This varied from the initial “sketch” layout done with mapping from the office.The install took about 6 hours to install including the morning layout planning.  It included 18 panels and inverter alongside an older system. It was up and fully running before they left and it has just worked with no concerns.I’d recommend ECG in a heartbeat to anyone, and I rarely recommend businesses or services to anyone as everyone’s experience may vary, but this business is set up well and has a very strong business etho’s.It’s a shame that not every business works to this standard, but when you find one they stand out.I’m very happy with my choice.ECG is on the Solar Quotes recommended installers, but oddly was not one of the one’s recommended to me.
Great service. Flexible installation dates/timing. Punctual, efficient and pleasant to deal with on the day. Everything works as planned.

They were the only company that payed attention to some of the specifics I asked for at the beginning.Over the course of asking questions and making changes to the system a few balls were dropped, but everything was resolved and they were courteous at all times.They did their best to minimise or remove all forms/administration (and the obligatory listening to hold music when calling government offices).There has been one glitch in the system since install, called them and it was resolved. No idea what it was though, hopefully a one off.

ECG Electrical PTY LTD in Canberra. They were the only ones of the three companies to quote.ECG are supplying and installing:19 Trina 415w panels6kw SolarEdge SE6000H Genesis Inverter (and panel optimisers)Consumption and WiFi monitoringTesla Powerwall 2EvoHeat Heat Pump 270 litre hot water serviceInstallation of solar and heat pump hot water is happening today 24 August 2022 and Tesla Powerwall 2 end of September early October due to supply delay.

Very professional from start to finish. Sales team were helpful and knowledgeable and happy to answer all my questions and explore options with no pressure to purchase or "option up". The installation team were friendly and professional, listened to my concerns and made sure I understood what they were doing, how my system would work, and the next steps - and left the site clean and tidy!
I found all ECG staff helpful in answering questions; they arrived on time for an onsite quote and when installing the system; and with a follow up call

I had the quote done remotely (without an onsite visit) and it worked brilliantly. I provided a photo of the meter box as requested and that was it. I had a detailed quote within hours.The telephone dealings with the office was excellent and the paperwork flowed easily.The team arrived on time which is a great sign being prompt. The Installation went very well and  I was consulted/kept informed as needed. BTW,  I was at home on the day. The installers were polite, well mannered and efficient. They kept the backyard clean and removed any rubbish from the packaging.I had arranged for the smart meter to be installed prior to the PV install and so I had the system fully up and running on the day. I had the system demonstrated to me including setting up the WiFi app.I am very pleased that I engaged ECG for my PV and I have no hesitation to put their name forward to my friends.

The sales process was first rate.  The person who came to talk to us knew exactly what he was doing and understood all of the options - it was not a scripted presentation as others had been.Installation was completed on the agreed date.  Very professional.  They actually left the site cleaner than when they found it.We have had some minor questions/issues since but ECG have resolved all of them quickly and efficiently.Cannot recommend highly enough

I got a lot of value through the SolarQuotes site in building my understanding of what I wanted out of a solar system, comparing options and getting information on installers. ECG worked with me during the quoting process to refine the solution based on my questions and feedback. They showed flexibility when parts were not available through offering different options at no cost. The install team had good communication and did a thorough job in the expected time. The system has been operating without issue for four months.
Very efficient, friendly and knowledgeable. They installed the panels and inverter in a few hours, explained everything and had me up and running very quickly.

The quotation process went well, the sales process not so much.I was quoted for 36 Trina Hone 330 panels and was delivered 29 Trina Honey 370 panels as they were more powerful. In fact, they were just larger and reduced my production from 11.88Kw to 10.73kW. I'm limited by the size of my roof. I screwed this up as the quote still had 36 panels listed. When I queried this on installation day, I was told that "they are bigger panels and the 330 panels are no longer available".Yes, they are bigger panels, in size, which is how they are higher rated, my error in not insisting on a resolution before I made payment.The inverter installation had some issues, as this was a very new Fronius Gen24+ 10kW and smart meter. Some minor issues with getting the smart meter to talk to the inverter, resolved the next day by ECG.I discussed battery options with the team, as it is my intention to instal a 13.8kWh HVM BYD. This is the only certified battery for the Fronius Gen24+.I asked for information regarding the wiring required to install the battery to the system and house and was informed that I should run 4 additional 10 mm2 from the installation to the main switch box. This is not required as the battery connects only to the inverter, the inverter carries the power to the main switch box.I later requested ECG for a further quotation for the battery. I had one call that indicated for sure, can be done. After receiving no follow up, I contacted ECG via email and my response was that they did not provide BYD batteries.i am currently looking elsewhere for the battery.I purchased the Fronius Gen24+ as it is the only inverter on the market, that I am aware of, that provides a one-stop solution. Panel, battery and full backup capability.I'm very happy with the system, notwithstanding the reduction in production. I am waiting now for certification of the BYDE battery for use with the EverGen VPP.

The quoting process was smooth. I was initially put-out by the online-only interactions, but all my questions were answered in detail (by email and phone) without "sales" language.My scheduled installation was about 2+ months after accepting the quote, not ideal, but I appreciated the integrity of the scheduling process and they confirmed with me a couple of weeks before the install. Install went reasonably smoothly on the day. Our installer was the second cheapest quote from the three, and the only one that made a site visit at the time they promised, providing options to choose from and answered all my questions. Initially the quote was for 17 panels and the others had quoted for 18 panels. I inquired if they could find the space for the additional panel, which they did and a new quote was provided. The cost of one additional panel was negligible to the overall price.Prior to the scheduled installation date I was advised that the original panels were not available and was provided with a choice of waiting for the agreed panels or accepting an alternate more expensive panel at no extra cost. The alternate panels were also Tier 1 and had a better efficiency so it was an easy choice and one I was happy to make.Issues discussed with our installer that might assist others were:- Microinverters or string inverter. Our roof has two areas for panels facing N and NW and there are no shading issues. Microinverters would have been an additional cost for potentially only a small gain.- Monitoring System. When considering if you want the additional cost, investigate what the inverter and also the energy company can provide (as well as a portable energy monitor). It might be more convenient to monitor current consumption/production but I can monitor daily consumption/production for previous days and can see the impact of turning on appliances (as long as I have made a note of when it was turned on). The installer provided access to the SEMS portal prior to acceptance of the quote enabling me view the functionality of demonstration solar (and battery) systems. My energy retailer provided no detail of what to expect and I have only got access a month after the install. I have included two screenshots. The inverter portal shows solar production (but not how much has been consumed/exported), the retailer portal shows hourly consumption and solar power exported with access to a CSV file providing all the figures.- 3 Phase Power. The house had 3 phase power when we bought it and retained it when it was rewired during a renovation. No one seems to believe it until they look at the switchboard. I wanted to explore the potential to have more than two arrays and increase the amount being exported. In the end, there was insufficient space on the roof for more than 18 panels so we agreed to the two arrays and 5kW string inverter.Installation was completed in a single day, the process was very efficient and I had a demonstration of the inverter app on the same day.I have had to restart my wireless router twice since the install and noticed that the inverter takes a long time to reconnect (can be up to an hour).
